newsitem.title: UK: LEP Australia gets new chief executive.
newsitem.headline: LEP Australia gets new chief executive.

text.p: UK-based global freight forwarder LEP International said Kevin Sowerby has been appointed chief executive of LEP International Pty Australia.
In a statement issued here, it said Sowerby was returning to the company after a spell working for the Lightning Group in New Zealand.
He is now based at LEP Australia's Melbourne headquarters.
Sowerby has had a long association with LEP, having joined the Freightways Group in 1980.
In 1984 he was appointed general manager of Freightways International and when that company merged with LEP in 1991, he became general manager of the newly-formed LEP Freightways International Ltd.
